description.value: Kickturn Coffee Roasters is a small-batch specialty cafe and in-house roaster founded in 2021 in Kimberley, BC, drawing its name from the deliberate ski-turn pivot that inspired the owner's career change and move to the Kootenays. The shop sources single-origin beans almost directly from a single farming family in Antigua, Guatemala, roasting to order for both walk-in visitors and a Canada-wide online subscription. Customer reviews highlight the owner's genuine passion and the welcoming atmosphere, making it a natural stop for cyclists passing through the East Kootenays.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms the business is a real, operating cafe and micro-roaster at 253 Wallinger Ave, Kimberley BC, matching the OSM address. Takeout/local pickup is explicitly confirmed in the FAQ. Wi-Fi is tagged in OSM (internet_access=yes, customers) but the website makes no mention of it, so it is left null per the rules. No bike parking, washroom, water refill, or other amenity details appear anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM opening_hours (Mo-Sa 07:30-15:00) conflicts with website hours (Mon-Fri 7:30am-2pm; weekends/holidays 9am-2pm): OSM omits Sunday and sets Saturday closing at 15:00, whereas website includes weekends at a later open time and earlier close time.
Phone number (+12509084367) not displayed anywhere on the website; contact page uses a form only — phone cannot be independently confirmed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible specialty coffee shop and micro-roaster in Kimberley — a clear stop for touring cyclists in the East Kootenays.

wow_evidence: small-batch specialty cafe and in-house roaster founded in 2021 in Kimberley... welcoming atmosphere
